# XYNTRIQ

> XYNTRIQ is the managed data partner for teams whose models have to work in the physical world. We collect and annotate consented egocentric (POV) video, image, audio, text and LiDAR data across India and Latin America, with documented consent per record and batch-level traceability. Pilot-first engagements, NDA and MSA friendly, India data residency.

## What we do

- [Data Annotation](https://xyntriq.in/services): image, video, text, audio, LiDAR, point cloud and multimodal annotation for production-grade models
- [Data Collection](https://xyntriq.in/services): custom image, video, egocentric (POV), audio, speech and sensor collection across India and Latin America
- [Data Validation and QA](https://xyntriq.in/services): independent validation, auditing and quality assurance with batch-level reporting
- [First-Person (POV) Video](https://xyntriq.in/phone-based-pov-vs-traditional-models): consented egocentric video datasets capturing real-world tasks from the person's own point of view
- [Dataset Curation](https://xyntriq.in/services): cleaning, balancing, deduplication and metadata enrichment of model-ready datasets

## Industries

- [Healthcare and Medical Imaging](https://xyntriq.in/healthcare-medical): MRI, DICOM and clinical annotation with de-identification first
- [LiDAR and 3D Sensing](https://xyntriq.in/lidar-3d-sensing): point cloud and 3D bounding box labeling
- [Geospatial and Remote Sensing](https://xyntriq.in/geospatial-remote-sensing): satellite and aerial imagery segmentation
- [Autonomous Vehicles and Robotics](https://xyntriq.in/automotive-robotics): perception data for physical AI
- [Agriculture and Farming](https://xyntriq.in/agriculture-farming): crop segmentation and keypoint annotation
- [Transportation and Logistics](https://xyntriq.in/transportation-logistics)
- [Retail and E-commerce](https://xyntriq.in/retail-ecommerce): product imagery datasets and attribute labeling
- [Audio and Transcription](https://xyntriq.in/transcription-audio): speech, transcription and multilingual audio corpora
- [All industries](https://xyntriq.in/industries)

## How we work

- Pilot first. A representative sample batch is annotated against your guidelines, and you measure quality against your own acceptance criteria before committing to volume.
- Fixed scope and a written quote, typically inside 48 hours of the pilot review.
- Multi-tier quality control with expert human review, batch-level acceptance thresholds and full traceability.
- Documented consent captured per record, not once at intake.
- Every engagement starts with an NDA and MSA.
- Udyam-registered Indian MSME with GST-compliant invoicing and India data residency, which makes us procurement-ready for enterprise and government programs.
